findings: F1 (medium, REQ-002, #13): deletePlan does 'await getDocs(daysCol).catch(() => getDocsFromCache(col))'. The real Firestore SDK getDocs never rejects when the backend is unreachable. Measured with firebase from the 30e33c3 lockfile: it resolves fromCache after 597 ms with the network hard down and 11093 ms when connections hang (artifacts/getdocs-offline-probe.txt). So the catch fallback is dead code. PlanDetailView awaits deletePlan before onBack, which freezes the UI about 11 s with no feedback on poor gym signal. tests/unit/deletion.test.ts mocks getDocs as an instant throw, which does not model the SDK (invariants Rule 4 adjacent). Fix: read days with getDocsFromCache first (the detail view already subscribes to them) or navigate before awaiting, and make the mock hang instead of throw.

F2 (low, #13 scope): plans archived before #13 are hidden everywhere (PlanListView filters archivedAt != null), so they can be neither restored nor hard-deleted. Abandoned sessions also persist invisibly. A PO decision on whether 'review the whole app' covers these.

F3 (low, #13): on the cache path deletePlan deletes only cached days. Days that were never synced to this device would stay orphaned under a deleted plan on the server. They are invisible but not cleaned up.
F4 (info, REQ-006): src/lib/db/sessions.ts is 292/300 lines. The next session feature will need an extraction.
F5 (residual, low, carried over): run.services.get is still denied for vibe-agent@ (traffic split, runtime SA, env).
F6 (info, carried over): /favicon.ico 404. COOP window.closed warnings from the Google popup. Live authenticated journeys need a PO smoke test.
